data.narrative:
Marathon Fusion is a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Adam Rutkowski and Kyle Schiller that has raised $10.9M to date. The valuation universe comprises 11 peers in nuclear energy—3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy—though narrow peer comparability is constrained at the Seed stage.

A single applicable method anchors this analysis: Stage-Progression, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $11M capital base, yielding $27M. A peer-median approach is not applicable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints within narrow filters (same stage, adjacent stage, similar valuation tier) preclude reliable median calculation without introducing material methodological bias.

The triangulated valuation range is $23M to $31M, centered on $27M. This reflects the single method's output with a ±15% sensitivity band. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x multiplier for frontier nuclear specifically (the comp set spans both modular and advanced reactor architectures at varying stages), and the absence of direct Seed-stage peer pricing, which necessitates reliance on stage-transition convention rather than market evidence. Extension to the next financing round or additional capital deployment will provide material new datapoints for refinement.
